verdict.rationale: Sumsub's Liveness docs name specific threats the check rejects: deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, photos of a screen and dolls. Liveness & Face match is a configurable verification step, and analysts can review results per applicant. This is more than a marketing mention, but camera-injection or virtual-camera attacks are never addressed. Missing for 10: documented camera-injection/virtual-camera defenses, technical detail on how deepfake detection works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
